answer: Trust should only cross between domains through a bridge that checks an anchor. Each vertex earns reputation inside one community, but to carry that reputation elsewhere it must post an anchor bond: a locked deposit tied to one hardware key, released only after a season of honest work. A Sybil farmer can mint a thousand vertices cheaply, yet every anchor costs real capital and time, and the bridge caps how much reputation a single anchor can move per epoch. A cloned swarm therefore arrives with empty pockets, while honest agents cross with their history intact.
